title: Exact Studio edits.json
description: A recording's timeline. Every time is in seconds of the recording. See docs/edits.md.

splits.description: Where the clip is cut, sorted

removed.description: The start of each clip part left out (0 or a split)

transitions.description: Keyed by the end of a kept part, in milliseconds

lanes.description: How many effect lanes the video has: they hold zoom, speed, spotlight, highlight, 3d, mask, and a blur or mono with no scope

textLanes.description: How many text lanes there are; a text's lane counts these. A file without it is an old one, and the app sorts its texts into text lanes

imageLanes.description: How many image lanes there are; an image's lane counts these, and a lower lane is in front. Images on one lane never overlap in time. A file without it is an old one, where each image had a lane of its own; each keeps it

frameLanes.description: How many whole-frame lanes there are: they hold a blur or mono with a scope past the video: background, scene, frame or all

y.description: Centre, 0–1 of the frame's height, from the top

scale.description: 1 fills the frame inside the padding

base.description: Where the video sits before any move. A missing x or y is 0.5, a missing scale 1

t.description: Seconds of the recording it lands at

y.description: Centre, 0–1 of the frame's height, from the top

scale.description: 1 fills the frame inside the padding

to.description: Where it lands. A missing x or y is 0.5, a missing scale 1

duration.description: Seconds it travels before t. Default 0.8

angles.description: Degrees: tilt leans the top away, turn swings the right side away, roll turns it flat. A missing one is 0; no angles keeps the angle it had.

volume.description: The recorded sound's volume; 0 mutes it. It follows every cut, speed change and fade.

soundLanes.description: How many sound lanes there are; a sound's lane counts these

sounds.description: Music and sounds played over the video. A sound is not cut or sped up by the video's cuts and speed changes: it starts at the moment of the recording `start` names (the next kept moment, if that is removed) and plays straight through for `length` seconds, or until the video ends.

id.description: Unique among the sounds, and without a colon

file.description: A path inside the recording's folder, in sounds/: M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF, AAC or CAF

lane.description: Its sound lane; two sounds on one lane never play at once

start.description: When it begins, in seconds of the recording

length.description: How many seconds of the file play

offset.description: Where in the file it starts, in seconds; offset + length must fit in the file

joinStart.description: true: it continues the sound of the same file on the same lane, in video time that ends where it starts, which has joinEnd: a split's second half. No fade where they meet. Default: not joined

joinEnd.description: true: the sound of the same file on the same lane, in video time that starts where it ends, which has joinStart, continues it: a split's first half. Default: not joined

end.description: Seconds of the recording; at least 0.1 after start

lane.description: Its lane among its own kind: an effect lane, a text lane, an image lane (0 in front) or a whole-frame lane. Two segments on one lane never overlap in time. Default 0

scope.description: blur, mono: where in the stack (background, video, images, texts, back to front) it cuts; it covers every layer under the cut. video: only the video (the default); background: only the background; scene: the background and the video; frame: those and the images, under the texts, which stay sharp; all: the texts too

style.description: text: plain, pill, box, outline, shadow; 3d: hold, orbit; mask: blur (the default), pixels, solid

x.description: text, image: centre, 0–1 of the frame's width

y.description: text, image: centre, 0–1 of the frame's height, from the top

size.description: text, image: height as a share of the frame's

color.description: text: one of the names. mask (solid): "#RRGGBB" or one of the names; default black

animIn.description: text: any of these. image: pop, fade, rise, slide, spin, blur, none

animOut.description: text: any of these. image: fade, pop, sink, blur, none

file.description: image: the picture, a path inside the recording's folder such as images/logo.png. `exact-studio image` copies a picture there

radius.description: image, mask: rounded corners, as a share of its shorter side

t.description: Seconds of the recording it lands at

y.description: Centre, 0–1 of the frame's height, from the top

scale.description: Multiplies the image's size: 1 keeps it

to.description: Where it lands. A missing x or y is 0.5, a missing scale 1

duration.description: Seconds it travels before t. Default 0.8

moves.description: image: its own moves. Each lands inside the image's span

effects.description: image: its own effects, each inside the image's span (blur, mono, fade, pulse, float, wiggle). text: its own blur, mono or fade, each inside the text's span

end.description: Seconds of the recording; at least 0.1 after start

lane.description: Its row under the image or the text

level.description: fade: the opacity it fades to

joinStart.description: true: it continues the effect of the same kind on the same row, of this image or one joined to it that ends where it starts, which has joinEnd: a split's second half. Nothing eases where they meet. Default: not joined

joinEnd.description: true: the effect of the same kind on the same row, of this image or one joined to it that starts where it ends, which has joinStart, continues it: a split's first half. Default: not joined

rect.description: mask: what it hides, in 0–1 of the full recorded frame (before the crop), origin top-left, so a later crop never moves it off the secret. Only the part inside the crop shows. `exact-studio frame <id> <t> --raw` renders that picture

w.description: Width; x + w is at most 1

h.description: Height; y + h is at most 1

joinStart.description: true: it continues the segment of the same kind on the same lane that ends where it starts, which has joinEnd: a split's second half. Where they meet nothing eases, enters or exits, a text's loop keeps its phase, and an image's moves and effects run across both. Default: not joined

joinEnd.description: true: the segment of the same kind on the same lane that starts where it ends, which has joinStart, continues it: a split's first half. Default: not joined

layer.description: text, image: where it sits in the stack (texts, images, video, behind the video, background, front to back). front: over the video (the default); behind: between the background and the video, so it shows around the video and where the video moves, shrinks, turns or is cropped away. Its lane, its row, stays

order.description: text, image: its place among the items of its kind in its layer; a higher one is in front. Default 0; a tie keeps the order without one: images by lane (0 in front), texts by their place in segments (a later one in front). Texts are always over images in the same layer
